questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign marks a railroad crossing ahead. It is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns drivers about a curve in the road to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is moving toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending and drivers must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings or symbols. They give drivers important information about road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a divided roadway coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you to slow down because the road will turn sharply ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road surface becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs are rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this railroad crossing sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if you see or hear one coming. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round yellow signs warn you about railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs tell you about motorist services nearby. These include rest areas, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is merging into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers they must follow a traffic law. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting and you should stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Triangle signs pointing downward mean you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs only warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may be merging into your lane.
